title: Single-Cell Multiplex Immune Biomarker Prediction from Histopathology Across Cancer Types and Clinical Endpoints.
snippet: Background The spatial organization of cellular lineages within the tumor microenvironment governs disease progression and therapeutic response, but multiplexed spatial profiling remains costly, technically complex, and tissue-destructive.
